caption: The drawing features three main outlined shapes and some annotations on a light beige background. The largest shape is a tall rectangle positioned on the left side and is labeled "G-3." It contains another vertical annotation running along its right edge that reads "CENTER BACK, NO SEAM," and additionally, a shorter vertical rectangle intersects the top edge, labeled "PLACKET." Immediately to its right is another upright rectangle with similar height but slightly narrower width, labeled "G-2." Both of these large rectangles are detailed with dashed lines near the top and bottom edges. In the lower right corner of the drawing, there is a smaller, rounded trapezoidal shape labeled "G-4," with an annotation "FOLD OF MATERIAL" along one straight edge. All shapes and text are rendered in thin, gray lines. The entire composition is bordered by a thin, large rectangular outline.
title: Pattern for a Dress
